segments.text: Meet IceGuard, an open-source console for Apache Iceberg. Schema, properties and snapshots, at a glance.
The storage view breaks down file sizes and partitions, so you can drill in and catch small-file problems early.
The timeline puts commits and maintenance runs side by side, and the evolution view diffs every schema version.
Maintenance is built in. Here we compact data files with a real Spark job, running locally. The result and the full Spark logs stream right into the dialog.
Alerts watch table health, and catalogs can be tagged and filtered.
Switch catalogs from the sidebar, browse namespaces, and create tables with a guided wizard.
Adding a catalog takes a minute: pick REST, Nessie, Polaris or Unity Catalog, set the URI and credentials, and tag it.
Pipelines chain maintenance actions on a schedule. IceGuard is free and open source. Find it on GitHub.
